description: Auto-mount ashpipe portals when Claude Code starts in an ashpipe workspace

hooks.command: if command -v ashpipe >/dev/null 2>&1; then dir="$PWD"; while [ "$dir" != "/" ]; do if [ -f "$dir/.ashpipe/config.yaml" ]; then (cd "$dir" && ashpipe mount 2>&1); break; fi; dir="${dir%/*}"; [ -n "$dir" ] || dir="/"; done; fi
